shotSize.label: 特写
shotSize.note: Use for tight facial detail or a single object that carries strong emotion.

shotSize.label: 近景
shotSize.note: Use for dialogue-driven beats where the character's face and upper body fill the frame.

shotSize.label: 中景
shotSize.note: Use as the workhorse framing for conversations and everyday action.

shotSize.label: 全景
shotSize.note: Use to show a character's whole body within their surroundings.

shotSize.label: 远景
shotSize.note: Use to establish a location or emphasize scale and isolation.

shotSize.label: 大远景
shotSize.note: Use for vast environments where the landscape itself is the subject.

shotSize.label: 建立镜头
shotSize.note: Use once per location to orient the viewer before cutting closer.

shotSize.label: 过肩镜头
shotSize.note: Use for dialogue to anchor the listener in frame.

shotSize.label: 插入镜头
shotSize.note: Use for a telling detail that punctuates the scene.

cameraMove.label: 固定机位
cameraMove.note: Use for calm, observational moments where the frame should not move.

cameraMove.label: 推镜头
cameraMove.note: Use to build intimacy or tension by moving closer to the subject.

cameraMove.label: 拉镜头
cameraMove.note: Use to reveal context or create a sense of detachment.

cameraMove.label: 摇镜头
cameraMove.note: Use to scan a space horizontally or vertically from a fixed position.

cameraMove.label: 移镜头
cameraMove.note: Use to travel with the subject through space for a fluid feel.

cameraMove.label: 跟镜头
cameraMove.note: Use to keep pace with a moving character and sustain momentum.

cameraMove.label: 升降
cameraMove.note: Use for sweeping vertical reveals or dramatic transitions.

cameraMove.label: 手持
cameraMove.note: Use for documentary-style immediacy and nervous energy.

cameraMove.label: 环绕
cameraMove.note: Use to circle the subject for a dramatic reveal.

cameraMove.label: 快速摇镜
cameraMove.note: Use a fast pan for abrupt, high-energy transitions.

cameraMove.label: 变焦推进
cameraMove.note: Use an in-lens zoom to intensify focus without moving the camera.

cameraMove.label: 变焦拉出
cameraMove.note: Use an out-lens zoom to widen context without moving the camera.
